195547.scope: Missing shape, size, list-length, or boundary validation causing out-of-bounds access, SIGFPE, or sanitizer-only undefined behavior in the missing-validation hardening class: invalid direct ATen/internal calls, extreme parameters, or empty/degenerate inputs. The check is absent in eager, not just lost under compilation. A fully covered instance may use this close policy without adding review solely for its OOB/SIGFPE/sanitizer symptom. Uncertain scope or additional unresolved impact requires review.
exclusions: Ordinary supported public-API usage with an unresolved actionable crash or correctness problem; route for review instead of assuming hardening.
Eager rejects the input but compilation loses that validation (see #197554).
Numerical precision, range, or derivative formula bugs without missing validation.
An existing member's own resolution or checklist status: this policy applies only to the new issue being triaged.

198017.scope: Forward-mode or higher-order AD returns wrong derivatives from per-op hand-written derivative rules, including nested JVP/jacfwd and custom autograd.Function jvp composition. The tracker explicitly keeps individual reproducer issues open.
exclusions: Unsupported forward AD or a missing derivative rule raising an error.
Low-precision inf/nan when the float64 derivative formula is correct.
Wrong derivatives only under torch.compile or first-order backward formula bugs.

197554.scope: Eager rejects an invalid input, but torch.compile, Dynamo, Inductor, or AOTInductor loses that validation and accepts it, returns garbage, or crashes. The tracker requests validation-preserving compiled paths and per-input coverage, without permission to close members as duplicates.
exclusions: Missing validation in eager too (the hardening class may fit #195547).
Eager-versus-compiled numerics, dtype promotion, NaN/inf propagation, or accumulation-order differences without a lost validation check.
Compiled rejects an input eager accepts.
